stances.summary: BYD's overseas sales surge as domestic market shrinks
stances.quote:
Bloomberg: BYD’s overseas revenue exceeded what it made at home for the first time, illustrating why Chinese carmakers have to sell outside of China. First-half sales from overseas rose 34% to account for 53% of the total, while they shrank 31% in Greater China.
www.bloomberg.com

stances.summary: Suggests Chinese regulators prioritize property market recovery
stances.quote: Not sure, but perhaps they were worried that tighter rules might slow down a recovery in the property market. Nearly all of their recent property-related policies have been in the direction of easing.

stances.summary: Characterizes property market as revealing deeper economic disparities
stances.quote:
Very interesting Caixin article on China's K-shaped property market, with a sliver of premium properties in top-tier cities seeming to recover strongly while everything else continues to flounder. As always, the property market is a mirror of the economy.

stances.summary: Argues China must raise childcare subsidies to address birth crisis
stances.quote:
SCMP: "Beijing should drastically raise its nationwide childcare subsidies to stave off a deepening birth crisis, according to Chinese scholars, who warned the country’s fertility rate could soon fall to the lowest in the world unless action was taken."
www.scmp.com/economy/chin.
